name: repowise
description: Fleet RepoWise workspace MCP pinned at C:/Repos. Enable only when code-intelligence tools are needed; disable when done.

interface.shortDescription: Federated code intelligence for every git repo under C:/Repos.
interface.longDescription: Each host session runs a small stdlib-only stdio bridge (scripts/repowise_bridge.py, launched windowless through pyw) that forwards to the one shared RepoWise server at http://127.0.0.1:7339/mcp. When the port is down the bridge starts it through scripts/Start-RepoWiseShared.ps1, hidden; that launcher fails closed rather than start RepoWise on a mock embedder. Never a scheduled or logon task. Never persist a stdio `repowise mcp` entry in host MCP config — it fans out one 220 MB server per host. Official RepoWise marketplace plugins are forbidden because they register a second MCP at the nearest repo instead of C:/Repos.
